scope_note: Two-pass public-evidence and corrective gap-closure audit for Flexential's Minneapolis-Chaska data center on parcel 30.0590020 at 3500 Lyman Boulevard. The review covered Carver County parcel, valuation-notice, tax-statement and payment records; City of Chaska permit, inspection, agenda, archive, budget, utility and annual-financial-report sources; Minnesota DEED, Revenue, statutory, environmental, workforce and utility-regulatory sources; federal environmental, workplace-safety and county-economic access points; current and archived operator, predecessor, career and ESG materials; contractor and supplier references; and education, workforce and recipient-reported community sources for 2013-2026. Twenty-three quantitative observations are preserved: a source-projected original investment lower bound; three later non-cumulative permit values; current floor area and critical-load UPS capacity; three annual parcel-tax payments; one current parcel-tax bill; five exact-parcel taxable-market-value stocks for payable 2023-2027; and eight historical Via West Inc. estimated-actual-value observations. The exact parcel statements crosswalk the 2023-2025 city-table values to parcel 30.0590020, but the duplicate value concepts are alternative assessor presentations and are not additive. Stream's facilities at 1706 and 1708 West Creek Lane, the IP Stream Minneapolis LLC development agreement and its municipal rebates are outside the selected 3500 Lyman Boulevard project boundary and are not duplicated in this fragment; the six base Stream rebate rows require reassignment or removal from this target by the orchestrator because project fragments are append-only. Permit values are administrative estimates and are not summed because scopes may overlap. Parcel taxes span all taxing jurisdictions and special assessments, not City-only receipts or net benefit. No synthesis fragment is added because candidate-by-candidate review found no defensible project inputs for construction labor, realized operating employment or payroll, supplier payments, metered energy or water, emissions, facility-specific incentive value, public-service costs, quantified community transfers, or a causal county employment, wage or GDP effect.

project_updates.title: Investment audit and project boundary correction
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: City development bulletins, Agenda Center and Archive Center; ViaWest, Flexential and Stream history; county ownership; Minnesota eCRV; contemporary coverage; and current operator materials for 2013-2026. Queries used ViaWest, Flexential, Stream, 3500 Lyman, 1706 and 1708 West Creek, Entegris and parcel 30.0590020. City evidence places ViaWest's adaptive reuse at the former Entegris headquarters, 3500 Lyman Boulevard, while Stream identifies separate facilities at 1706 and 1708 West Creek Lane. The exact parcel eCRV search returned no record, but public coverage begins after the reported 2013 acquisition; agenda/archive searches are metadata-bounded. The opening release supports only a greater-than-$60 million source projection, not realized investment. No acquisition price, final conversion cost, audited capital ledger or annual facility capital series was located. Append-only fragments cannot correct the base aggregate: reassign clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2020, clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2021, clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2022, clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2023, clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2024 and clm_study_chaska_stream_rebate_2025 to the separate Stream Minneapolis I / West Creek project, or remove them from this target before the next aggregate release. The target label should be normalized to 'Flexential Minneapolis-Chaska (ViaWest)' and opening timing to April 2014; candidate metadata is outside fragment scope.
project_updates.project_description: Flexential's Minneapolis-Chaska facility is a single adaptive-reuse colocation data center operated by Flexential on parcel 30.0590020 at 3500 Lyman Boulevard in Chaska, Carver County, Minnesota. ViaWest acquired the former Entegris headquarters in 2013, renovated it, and opened more than 70,000 square feet of raised floor in April 2014; Peak 10 combined with ViaWest in 2017 and the business adopted the Flexential name in 2018. The current operator reports a 160,838-square-foot footprint and 9 MW of critical-load UPS capacity; later tenant-driven expansion and Phase 5 work at this parcel are separate from the original conversion, and Stream's 1708 West Creek Lane facility is outside this project boundary.

project_updates.title: Construction audit adds three bounded permit estimates
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: City SmartGov parcel, permit and inspection records; City archives and agendas; contractor cases; operator expansion materials; and contemporary construction coverage. Exact-address and parcel searches found B24-1109 ($5,861,872, PCL, issued January 23, 2025, unclosed), M24-0677 ($1,272,191, Metropolitan Mechanical/API HVAC, issued the same day, expired unclosed) and M26-0403 ($293,000, Climate Makers/EVER, issued August 10, 2026, open with final partially approved). These are administrative estimated values including labor, not paid costs, payroll, worker counts, completion or original conversion investment. Possible overlap between B24-1109 and M24-0677 is unresolved, so no portfolio sum is created. Related P26-0523 ($3,000) is excluded as overlapping M26-0403; BP26-0072 has no value; cancelled/expired B24-0504 ($150,000) is excluded. SmartGov's displayed history begins in 2022, so original conversion records require a City request.

project_updates.title: Supplier audit preserves payment and locality gaps
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: PCL project records, SmartGov contractor rosters, operator vendor references, trade coverage, City procurement and agenda searches, and exact-address web/archive searches. Queries used 3500 Lyman, Flexential Chaska, ViaWest Chaska, PCL, contractor, supplier, vendor, subcontractor, procurement and payment. PCL is identified for the 2021 expansion and B24-1109; Metropolitan Mechanical/API HVAC for M24-0677 and value-less BP26-0072; Climate Makers/EVER for M26-0403 and overlapping P26-0523; and VINCO only on excluded cancelled permit B24-0504. No contract payment, subcontractor ledger, procurement total, vendor location, local-retention share, certified payroll or worker-residence record was located. This is a public supplier-payment gap, not evidence that no subcontracting, procurement or local spending occurred; contractor identity is not converted into supplier spending, indirect jobs, payroll or multiplier effects.

project_updates.title: Operations audit adds scale but not employment
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: current and archived Flexential and ViaWest facility pages, opening and rebrand releases, careers and Workday postings, corporate reports, City employer tables, Minnesota DEED workforce/business-subsidy access points, OSHA establishment search and local-business coverage. Queries used Flexential Chaska, ViaWest Chaska, 3500 Lyman, Data Center Technician, employees, jobs, headcount, wages, payroll, residence, union, apprenticeship, careers, revenue and occupancy. Current operator materials support 160,838 square feet and 9 MW of critical-load UPS capacity. A Chaska vacancy and generic 24/7 staffing language do not disclose filled site FTE, wages, payroll, residence, occupancy, revenue or operating expenditure. OSHA's exact establishment query timed out, and indexed address searches produced only pre-project Entegris material; that unsuccessful bounded search cannot establish absence of inspections or injuries. No operating labor or output projection suitable for preservation was located.

project_updates.title: Fiscal audit verifies parcel payments and current owner
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Carver County parcel, assessment, tax-statement and payment portals; City annual financial reports and budgets; taxpayer tables; and exact owner, parcel and address searches. Parcel 30.0590020 links FLEXENTIAL LLC to 3500 Lyman, 33.03 acres, industrial class 234, no listed TIF project and exact paid totals of $534,380 in 2023, $551,454 in 2024 and $582,406 in 2025. The 2026 $632,906 bill is entered separately; only one $316,453 installment was paid at review, so no full-year 2026 paid record is created. City Table 9 supports a separate Via West Inc. estimated-actual-value series for payable 2015-2022 ($11.6063 million to $13.894 million, peaking at $14.2431 million in 2021). Those unaudited company-city rows are not explicit parcel records and are not stitched to current Flexential values without a direct crosswalk. No recipient distribution, marginal service cost, incidence, causal increment or net fiscal result was located.

project_updates.title: Public-cost audit separates ViaWest certification from Stream rebates
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Minnesota DEED certification lists and program summaries, Department of Revenue guidance, governing statute, the 2025 state tax-incentive evaluation, City tax-abatement notes, parcel TIF status, development-agreement archives and state/local financial reports. DEED separately lists certified ViaWest, Stream and Stream II projects; the Flexential parcel has no listed TIF project. Revenue guidance says the electricity exemption ended July 1, 2025. The state evaluation reports more than $90 million in statewide reduced revenue for 2015-2022 and modeled statewide employment/return findings, but no project allocation is defensible. Certification does not disclose ViaWest/Flexential refund or exemption value, qualifying purchases, compliance, clawback or disbursement. IP Stream rebates belong to the separate West Creek project. No Flexential-specific local payment, infrastructure subsidy, public-service cost or net public cost was located; that is non-quantification, not proof no benefit or cost existed.

project_updates.title: Resource audit finds capacity but no meter-level use
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Chaska electric, water, sewer, budget, rate and billing sources; Minnesota PUC, MPCA What's in My Neighborhood and DNR indexes; Carver hazard planning; operator facility/ESG materials; and exact-address environmental searches. Operator pages report 9 MW critical-load UPS capacity and a 1.4 PUE rating, while the 2014 City budget aggregates ViaWest with several large users. MPCA site 145467 identifies active underground-tank activity TS0126051, 2015/2024 inspections, and a citation warning discovered September 5, 2024 and closed November 7, 2024 with no net penalty; zero documents or quantities are exposed. Exact PUC and DNR searches found no target-specific docket/permit, but these indexed non-results do not prove none exists. No facility meter, annual kWh, peak demand, bill, water, wastewater, generator runtime, fuel, actual emissions, utility-infrastructure cost or monetized effect was located. Fleet-wide figures are not allocated to Chaska.

project_updates.title: Community audit finds no quantified site transfer
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Flexential/ViaWest ESG, news and community materials; City and county agendas/archives; Eastern Carver County Schools and Southwest Metro Intermediate District references; CareerForce and Minnesota DEED workforce sources; local nonprofit and recipient sites; and exact-address searches. Queries used Flexential Chaska, ViaWest Chaska, 3500 Lyman, grant, donation, sponsorship, nonprofit, school, training, workforce, apprenticeship, union and community benefit. No Chaska-specific recipient-reported cash or in-kind transfer, community-benefit agreement, workforce-program payment, school partnership, annual contribution, local-procurement pledge or facility-attributable value was located. The 2025 ESG material names nationwide organizations but does not locate spending at Chaska. This establishes a documentation gap, not that no community activity occurred; fleet-wide initiatives and qualitative engagement are not assigned to this parcel or monetized.

project_updates.title: Corrective parcel, transaction and incentive gap closure
project_updates.notes: Second-pass searches used Carver County Property Information parcel 300590020 and its Statements & Notices links; 2024, 2025 and 2026 tax statements; the taxes-payable-2027 valuation notice; Minnesota eCRV; MNCAR transaction reports; City taxpayer tables; DEED qualified-data-center lists; Revenue guidance; ViaWest releases; and exact owner/address queries. The statements add a direct taxable-market-value crosswalk for payable 2023-2027: $17,978,400, $18,976,500, $19,775,100, $20,637,500 and $23,544,000. These stocks are not additive to equal city principal-taxpayer values, taxes or investment. MNCAR reports the 2013 Entegris-to-ViaWest building sale at $6.8 million, but acquisition consideration is not renovation cost and the schema has no acquisition-price metric. The 2027 notice's $20,629,900 new-improvement field uses a five-year lookback and is not project spending. ViaWest's 2015 release confirms qualification for customer IT sales-tax treatment but discloses no exemption, refund, compliance or clawback amount. Exact eCRV remained empty for the parcel and exact-address financing, bond, PILOT, TIF, abatement, grant, audit, budget and check-register searches yielded no attributable project payment or debt; indexed/public non-results do not establish that none existed.

project_updates.title: Corrective permit, utility, infrastructure and environmental gap closure
project_updates.notes: Second-pass permit and regulatory searches covered City SmartGov exact parcel/address history; Minnesota DLI permit and license access; Chaska 2014, 2021, 2022 and 2023 budgets; City electric rates and system descriptions; Minnesota PUC, MPCA WIMN and DNR indexes; EPA ECHO's exact-address feature service; operator pages; architect and contractor records. SmartGov findings and exclusions remain B24-1109, M24-0677, M26-0403, overlapping P26-0523, value-less BP26-0072 and cancelled B24-0504. Secondary indexes surfaced DLI electrical identifiers ELE1409-00103, ELE1409-03612/03613, ELE1503-01157, ELE1504-01619, ELE1509-03092/06560/08788, ELE1510-08703, ELE1511-02771/02785/04086/08397/08401, ELE1601-02146 and ELE1607-06102, but the public DLI workflow did not expose primary historical permit facts suitable for claims. City budgets describe aggregate system growth and West Creek substation/switchgear work but do not allocate capacity or cost to parcel 30.0590020; published rates cannot produce a bill without measured demand/use. MPCA exposes tank/inspection status but no quantities, and ECHO's exact-address result remains named ENTEGRIS B4 without an operator-continuity link, so its counts are not assigned to Flexential. No meter-level electricity, water, wastewater, fuel, generator runtime, emissions, infrastructure payment or facility allocation was found.

project_updates.title: Corrective workforce, supplier, community and contract gap closure
project_updates.notes: Second-pass searches covered Flexential Workday and Greenhouse postings; DEED QCEW, workforce and business-subsidy access points; City budgets, agendas and check-register terms; SmartGov contractors; PCL and The Mulhern Group project pages; exact-address supplier/procurement searches; OSHA; recipient-side school, training, nonprofit and sponsorship sources; and operator ESG/community materials. Workday requisition R0000002269 reports a Chaska technician vacancy at $19-$21 per hour, but vacancy terms are not filled employment, realized wages, annual payroll or worker residence. PCL, Metropolitan Mechanical/API HVAC, Climate Makers/EVER and design/permit sources identify participants but not contract payments, certified payroll, subcontractors, vendor locations or local-retention shares. The 2014 Aspirations in Computing recipient program confirms a ViaWest financial sponsorship but does not identify ViaWest's generic tier, cash amount, in-kind value or facility allocation. Exact searches found no facility-specific workforce grant, training contract, apprenticeship, union agreement, community-benefit agreement, quantified donation, supplier payment or procurement ledger. OSHA timed out and the failure is not an absence finding.

project_updates.title: Independent candidate-by-candidate modeling and county-outcome decision
project_updates.notes: Residual-gap candidates were reviewed independently after direct-source closure. Investment: rejected; the $6.8 million acquisition and greater-than-$60 million forecast have different scopes and no realized conversion ledger. Construction: rejected; permit estimates overlap, remain partly unclosed and provide no workers, hours, payroll or local share. Suppliers: rejected; participant names lack payments and locality. Operations: rejected; a vacancy wage and facility scale lack filled FTE, payroll, occupancy and output. Fiscal: rejected; multi-jurisdiction levy totals lack marginal service cost, recipient attribution and a defensible counterfactual. Public costs: rejected; qualification and statewide tax-expenditure totals lack facility purchases or allocation. Resources: rejected; 9 MW UPS capacity and PUE cannot be converted to use, cost or emissions without occupancy, load and meter inputs. Community: rejected; recipient-confirmed sponsorship has no amount, tier or parcel allocation. County employment and wages: rejected; DEED QCEW aggregates county/all-industry or Information-sector establishments, protects small cells and has no facility identifier, while 2016-2017 geocoding changes and competing development undermine a before/after interpretation. County GDP: rejected; BEA CAGDP1 for FIPS 27019 is available but has no facility linkage or counterfactual, and UnitedHealth operated a separate Chaska data center before ViaWest's 2014 opening. Forecast additions: zero. Modeled additions: zero. Modeled removals: zero because no scoped modeled synthesis existed. Every category remains an explicit gap where inputs fail scope, source quality or attribution; no synthesis fragment is created.
